description: Add, update or remove an external link safety rule. Every change requires an approved request. Requires a service JWT obtained from the caller PDS (com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth) with aud set to the admin service DID and lxm set to the invoked method.

input.description: Operation input. add and update take url, pattern, action, reason, source and comment; remove takes url, pattern, source and comment.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the permission for this method.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The upstream service credential is not configured.

errors.name: UpstreamAuthFailed
errors.description: The upstream service rejected the administrator credential.

errors.name: UpstreamUnavailable
errors.description: The upstream service is unreachable, timed out or returned an unexpected payload.

errors.name: RateLimited
errors.description: The upstream service rate limited the request.

errors.name: ApprovalRequired
errors.description: Link safety changes require an approved request.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The rule input is invalid or conflicts with an existing rule.
